tools.name: convert_to_csv
tools.description: Convert a table to CSV without changing any value; verified by round-trip. Costs $0.05 USDC (x402).

tools.name: deduplicate
tools.description: Remove duplicate rows by exact key, keeping the first or last, and report conflicting columns per group. Costs $0.05 USDC (x402).

tools.name: reconcile
tools.description: Compare two versions of a table by key: rows added, removed and changed (with the changed columns). Costs $0.05 USDC (x402).

tools.name: verify_payment
tools.description: Verify an on-chain payment without trusting any RPC: did this tx transfer at least this amount of a token (default USDC) to this payee, optionally from this payer? Proven by Plumb (Base via proof-backed L1 checkpoints, Ethereum via a light client, XRP Ledger via a quorum of Ripple's validator list:

tools.name: try_verify_payment
tools.description: Free: the same verification as verify_payment, limited to 3 NEW claims per client per day (asking again about a claim already checked is always free). Holders of the exchange's on-ledger ProvenPayer credential get more: pass xrplProof (see credential_status).

tools.name: get_verification
tools.description: Free. Current state of a verification by checkId; re-checks it once its retry or challenge time has passed.

tools.name: watch_verification
tools.description: Free for a PAID check: add a callback (https) that receives signed events when requiredLevel is reached, when the answer changes, when it becomes final, or when checking gives up. The service re-checks on its own.

tools.name: verify_payments_batch
tools.description: Verify up to 25 payments in one call for $0.25 ($0.05 when every claim is on the XRP Ledger) USDC (x402): give `claims` (same fields as verify_payment) or `csv` (header: chain,txHash,payee,token,minAmountRaw,payer,logIndex,invoiceId). Claims already checked cost nothing; if all of them were, nothing

tools.name: get_verifications
tools.description: Free. Up to 50 checks at once (re-checked when due), as rows; format "csv" adds a reconciliation CSV.

tools.name: check_x402_receipt
tools.description: Free. Cross-check a seller's signed x402 offer + receipt (offer-and-receipt extension): verifies the signatures (official x402 functions; pin the seller with sellerAddress for EIP-712 or sellerJwk for JWS), checks offer and receipt agree, and returns the exact `claim` to prove with verify_payment. tools.name: what_should_i_build
tools.description: What should I build? x402 agent demand by category from public chain data (Base USDC + XRPL), with fake demand removed (testers, sellers paying themselves, loops; wallet fleets counted as one buyer) and gaps ranked (repeat buyers per seller). Rolling 7 days, refreshed every 2 h. Signed answer with s

tools.name: credential_status
tools.description: Free. The exchange's on-ledger ProvenPayer credential (XLS-70): issued to an XRPL account after 2 settled, Plumb-proven payments to the house; readable by any seller with ledger_entry. Returns the account's standing, the issued credential (with the CredentialCreate hash, provable with plumb-xrpl), h

tools.name: prove_xrpl_transaction
tools.description: Prove any XRP Ledger transaction without trusting a server: validator-list quorum, hash links, rebuilt tx tree. Returns full fields, metadata (balances, escrows, channels, credentials as of the tx), quorum evidence and a signed receipt. Unvalidated tx keeps your payment.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Free. Status and (once verified) the result of a paid job, using the accessToken its paid call returned.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "prove_xrpl_transaction" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
